name: rc1-corridor-aerial
js:
(() => { const app = window.__CITY_APP, C = window.CITY, a = C.worldFromLatLon(43.6408, -79.401), b = C.worldFromLatLon(43.644, -79.383);
app.teleportTo(a.x, a.z, 0); app.cameraSystem.cinema = () => ({ pos: [a.x, 45, a.z], look: [b.x, 0, b.z], fov: 50 }); })()
